<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the distinct chemical shift values are 139.25, 134.60, 129.00, 128.30, 49.40, 26.10, and 11.40 ppm. Identical values (129.00 and 128.30 each appear twice) correspond to equivalent carbons. Therefore, there are 7 unique carbon environments.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
